about: D11-1, roles inside a unit (docs/design/war.md §14.1; D-112). Beside his rank a soldier or sergeant may hold one role that uses what else he knows. Each role: the skill it uses (and a second), the least skill a captain will take for it (a level's value), its pay in suns a month, what it adds to the company (D11-2 makes the campaign measures read it), when it is wanted most, its line of promotion (D11-3), and the duty its card puts before the holder. A company has one holder of each role. Read by src/war/9999955-muster (A.MUSTER).

roles.name: clerk
roles.adds: the company's roll, pay and stores kept true
roles.duty: The captain's roll and the paymaster's do not agree by eleven names, and pay day is on Friday.

roles.name: forager
roles.adds: fewer men straggling and fewer hungry days
roles.duty: The bread is two days late and the country round the camp is bare. Somebody must find something.
roles.say: you know the land and what it feeds

roles.name: pathfinder
roles.adds: the road found sooner, fewer wrong turns
roles.duty: The column must be over the hills by dark, and the map shows a road the shepherds say is gone.
roles.say: you can find a road where there is none

roles.name: farrier
roles.adds: fewer horses lamed on the march
roles.duty: Three horses came in lame from the patrol, and the captain wants them sound for the escort.
roles.say: you know horses and their feet

roles.name: surgeon's mate
roles.duty: A fever has come into the lines: four men down and the cook among them.
roles.say: you have dressed wounds and set bones

roles.name: signaller
roles.adds: orders heard over the noise, a rally sooner
roles.duty: The new horn calls are to be learned by the whole company before the review.
roles.say: you can sound a horn or keep a drum

roles.name: standard-bearer
roles.adds: the company holds together round its colours
roles.duty: The colours are old and torn, and the captain wants them carried at the review as if they were new.

roles.name: provost's man
roles.adds: fewer men slipping away and less plunder
roles.duty: Two men are missing from the morning count, and the provost wants them found before the captain asks.
roles.say: men do as you tell them

roles.name: cook
roles.adds: less sickness in camp, better spirits
roles.duty: The salt pork has turned and the men are muttering. Supper is in three hours.
roles.say: you can feed many from little

roles.name: carpenter
roles.adds: over the stream an hour sooner, carts mended on the road
roles.duty: The bridge on the post road is out and the company is to cross it tomorrow with the carts.
